title: Bad Timing: A Sensual Obsession
description: A Viennese detective (Harvey Keitel) asks an American psychiatrist (Art Garfunkel) about his lustful girlfriend (Theresa Russell) in the emergency room.

title: Dead Man
description: Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.

title: Justin Bieber's Believe
description: Pop superstar Justin Bieber talks about his music, relationships and growing up in the spotlight. Concert footage, behind-the-scenes access, and appearances by Usher, Ludacris and other performers augment Bieber's narrative.

title: Gerry
description: After stopping their car for a hike, two men (Casey Affleck, Matt Damon) get lost in the desert without food or water.

title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
description:
S01 E01
An Old West poker player, his pal and an ex-madam meet vintage TV heroes and danger on the way to a big game.

title: Guns of Redemption
description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel.

title: The Kid
description: The Little Tramp (Charlie Chaplin) raises the abandoned child (Jack Coogan) of an unwed mother (Edna Purviance).

title: Starcrash
description: A space explorer and his girlfriend try to protect Earth from devastation.

title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
description: In the central story, Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) struggles with his inner demons and tries to maintain control until his former lover, Ava Lord (Eva Green), returns wanting his help to escape her abusive husband.

title: The Big Sleep
description: Private eye Philip Marlowe falls into a porno/blackmail/murder case in the 1970s London.

title: Misbehaviour
description: A team of women hatches a plan to disrupt the 1970 Miss World beauty competition in London.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Sharktopus vs. Whalewolf
description: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a hybrid of a killer whale and a wolf.

title: The Gambler
description: An Old West poker player (Kenny Rogers) acquires a sidekick (Bruce Boxleitner) and sets out to help the son he never knew.

title: The Protector
description: Two NYPD cops are sent to Hong Kong to catch a drug lord who has kidnapped the daughter of his former associate.

title: Take Me Home Tonight
description: A directionless college grad (Topher Grace) sees a chance to win the girl of his dreams when she invites him to a huge end-of-summer party.

title: White Zombie
description: A plantation owner takes the help of a voodoo master to lure an innocent woman, even though she loves someone else.

title: Bullet in the Head
description: Three Hong Kong gang fighters (Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee) try crime in Vietnam and land in a prison camp with U.S. soldiers.

title: Elegy
description: A beautiful student (Penélope Cruz) throws into disarray the life of an aging lecturer and cultural critic (Ben Kingsley) when she awakens in him feelings of sexual possessiveness.

title: Dreamscape
description: Two scientists (Kate Capshaw, Max von Sydow) have a psychic (Dennis Quaid) enter other's dreams to help them overcome their nightmares.

title: City of Industry
description: A retired thief (Harvey Keitel) joins his brother and two accomplices in Los Angeles for a final heist.

title: Silent House
description: Horrifying events turn panic to real terror when a young woman (Elizabeth Olsen) becomes trapped in the old house she's helping her father and uncle renovate.

title: A Boy and His Dog
description: A young man and his talking canine set out in search of food, shelter and females in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

title: My Sassy Girl
description: A guy (Jesse Bradford) has his life planned out, until he is wooed, groomed and then dumped by an elusive woman (Elisha Cuthbert).

title: Cobra Verde
description: A Brazilian plantation owner sends an employee (Klaus Kinski) to West Africa to re-establish a slave network.

title: Journey to the End of the Night
description: A man (Brendan Fraser) hatches a scheme to double-cross his father (Scott Glenn) and steal money from a drug deal.

title: The Poker House
description: Agnes and her two sisters struggle through the day in a home overrun by gamblers, thieves, and johns.

title: Sabrina the Teen-age Witch
description: The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.

title: Some Girl
description: An insecure young woman (Marissa Ribisi) and her promiscuous best friend (Juliette Lewis) seek relationships.

title: Black Sabbath
description: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

title: The Kill Room
description: A hit man teams up with an art dealer for a money-laundering scheme that unwittingly turns him into an avant-garde sensation.

title: Saturn 3
description: A madman (Harvey Keitel) and his shiny robot chase a May-December couple (Farrah Fawcett, Kirk Douglas) doing food research on Saturn's third moon.

title: Song to Song
description: Two struggling songwriters (Ryan Gosling, Rooney Mara), a music mogul (Michael Fassbender) and a waitress (Natalie Portman) chase success through a rock 'n' roll landscape of seduction and betrayal in Austin, Texas.

title: Paper Man
description: A frustrated novelist begins to depend less on his imaginary friend when he forms a unique bond with a Long Island teenager.

title: Castle Falls
description: A hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished, but no one knows that a gang leader hid $3 million in stolen cash inside. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

title: An Eye for an Eye
description: A San Francisco policeman (Chuck Norris) quits the force to avenge his partner's murder by Asian drug dealers.

title: The Little Hours
description: A young servant fleeing from his master takes refuge at a dysfunctional convent in medieval Tuscany, disguising himself as a deaf-mute.

title: Eyes Without a Face
description: A Paris surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with skin from kidnapped women.

title: The Wendell Baker Story
description: An amiable con artist (Luke Wilson) helps retirement-home residents fight back against a mean-spirited nurse (Owen Wilson) who steals their money and treats them like slaves.

title: Good Fences
description: A black attorney (Danny Glover), his wife (Whoopi Goldberg) and their two children move to a posh neighborhood in Greenwich, Conn.

title: The General
description: Johnny Gray (Buster Keaton) facing off against Union soldiers during the American Civil War. When Johnny's fiancée, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack), is accidentally taken away while on a train stolen by Northern forces, Gray pursues the soldiers.
